description_en: Creates a resource diagnostic report. Based on the diagnostic metric set ID that you specify, a diagnostic report is generated for multiple diagnostic metrics. You can call DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes with the returned diagnostic report ID to query the details of the resource diagnostic report
description_zh: 调用CreateDiagnosticReport创建资源诊断报告。根据您传入诊断指标集合ID，生成多个诊断指标的诊断报告。您可以根据返回的诊断报告ID，调用DescribeDiagnosticReportAttributes查询资源诊断详情
kebab_example: aliyun ecs create-diagnostic-report --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-id i-uf6i0tv2refv8wz00000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDiagnosticReport

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The diagnostic metric set ID. If left empty, the default diagnostic metric set dms-instancedefault for ECS instances is used
parameters.help_zh: 诊断指标集合ID。如果为空，则会使用ECS实例的默认诊断指标集合dms-instancedefault
parameters.name: metric_set_id

parameters.help_en: The start time. Takes effect only for diagnostic metrics that do not require Cloud Assistant commands to be run in the guest OS
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间。只对无需在GuestOS内执行云助手指令的诊断指标生效
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time. Takes effect only for diagnostic metrics that do not require Cloud Assistant commands to be run in the guest OS
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间。只对无需在GuestOS内执行云助手指令的诊断指标生效
parameters.name: end_time

ReportId.description_en: The diagnostic report ID, which is the unique identifier of the resource diagnostic report
ReportId.description_zh: 诊断报告ID，资源诊断报告的唯一标志
